title: Console: Tab & Focus Model + RTL Localization Prep for Dashboards and Rollouts
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem statement: Several Console surfaces (Dashboards, Rollouts list, and Cost breakdown panels) currently have inconsistent keyboard focus behavior, fragile focus rings when components virtualize, and color assets that fail WCAG AA for some token combinations and localized currency formats. We also need to make sure layout & microcopy are RTL-ready and that localized strings (pluralization and number/currency formats) don’t break spacing or overflow.

Goal: Deliver a small, audit-backed design pass and prototype that enforces a consistent tab/focus model, fixes contrast failures for cost sparkline and badge colors, and provides guidance & an RTL prototype so engineering can implement without regressions. The outcome should be a clear handoff with AC, test plan, and a lightweight Figma prototype demonstrating keyboard-only flows and RTL snapshots.

Scope: Dashboard overview (cards, charts, cost summary), Rollouts list + detail drawer, and Cost view table with per-route breakdowns. Exclusions: Console-wide language switcher implementation (PM will own), chart rendering engine internals (ENG), and server side localization plumbing.

Design approach:
- Use a roving tabindex pattern for virtualized lists (Rollouts) and explicit focus-visible styles consistent with platform tokens.
- Replace current color token pairs for badges and sparklines with WCAG AA-compliant variants and document alpha overlays for disabled states.
- Provide RTL layout checks focusing on spacing, icon mirroring, and text truncation rules for long localized labels (German) and narrow scripts (Japanese).
- Prepare a list of i18n-ready copy tokens for pluralization and currency grammar (en, de, ja, ar).
acceptance_criteria: All interactive elements in Dashboard, Rollouts, and Cost view follow a documented keyboard tab sequence and visible focus state (no hidden focus).
Virtualized Rollouts list uses roving tabindex prototype and keyboard-expand/contract behavior demonstrated in Figma.
Color token set for badges, status chips, and sparklines meets WCAG AA contrast against the background in light and dark themes (test matrix attached).
RTL snapshots show mirrored layout, icon directionality corrected, and no clipped/truncated localized strings in the tested languages.

Handoff doc includes engineering notes for CSS patterns (focus-visible, outline-offset, prefers-reduced-motion caveat) and a short test plan for screen readers (VoiceOver, NVDA) and keyboard-only testing.
review_feedback: PM (Ana Torres) - Please confirm languages to validate for rollout labels. Suggest adding French to the list; noted translation budget constraint.
Eng (Ravi Patel) - Prototype roving tabindex is helpful; ENG-3782 will wire the virtualized list. Need explicit aria-expanded/aria-controls IDs in the handoff.
Accessibility reviewer (Jules Park) - Focus rings are good but current icon-only buttons need aria-labels; note NVDA issues with table row expansion (we should add aria-live announcements).
Design lead (Sara O'Neil) - Prefer stronger outline-offset for dark mode to avoid overlap with card shadows; adjust token names to match palette v2.
